verdicts.why: The Watcher takes Peggy while she raids Batroc's ship in her own world, and in the closing scene she and her world's Natasha find the Hydra Stomper armor on the ship with someone inside.

In What If...?#18 Peggy's home world appears only in illusion and flashback; she is in 1602, the Sanctum Infinitum, the Hydra-destroyed world, Strange's reforged universe and the Observational Plane, and asks to see the multiverse before going home.
The episode opens in 1602, where Strange Supreme and Peggy catch up and he agrees to help her home, taking her to the Sanctum Infinitum.

On screen Strange seals Killmonger and Zola in a pocket dimension as the Watcher sends him back to his ruined universe, where he keeps watch over it; this event is in Strange's world in this title. The Guardians' battle itself is in Ultron's world, so this is the only entry that belongs here.
Same event as item 21: back home, Peggy and her world's Natasha find the Hydra Stomper armor on Batroc's ship with someone inside.

value: Ogden drugs Ben and brings him to Dr. Faber's lab, where she finds a cure, and Ben escapes with it after Silvermane raids the lab and Dirk Leyden kills Faber and Ogden.
verdicts.why: The entry fails P2: in episode 6 Ben is already the Spider again (since episode 2) and Faber never pulls him back in; episode 6 is Ogden taking him to Faber's lab, the cure, Silvermane's raid and Leyden killing Faber and Ogden. Moving the premise to #1 would also be wrong, since Faber first appears in episode 5.
The Marvel Database's Earth-TRN250 (Solarman pilot) and Wikipedia both name the teenager Ben Tucker; nothing names him Ben Collins.
In the 1994 film a fake diamond leaves the four exposed to cosmic rays from the passing comet Colossus; the cosmic storm is the 2005 film's origin.
The GSA that hunts the new mutants is Genomex's own security wing, founded and led by Mason Eckhart, so 'the Genomex agency' is loose but not false; under the evidence rule it passes.
Tony had already built the armor before the crash, and it saves him by implanting a device in his chest when Howard's plane goes down; he then goes out in it and the media dub him Iron Man.
Episode 26 'This Al Dente Earth!': Galactus comes to devour Earth and the Squad must get Doctor Doom to help reforge the Infinity Sword; the current text is the season premise, not this episode.
Only Reed, Johnny, Victor and Ben make the trip to Planet Zero, and Victor is lost when the ground erupts; Sue brings them back, and the four are changed when the Quantum Gate explodes on Earth.
